description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named 'HelloController' that exposes several endpoints including a welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info. It includes Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for a demo application including welcome, docs redirect, health, and info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a greeting message when accessing the root URL.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI page, preserving the original scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns application information including the project name.
